adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sync is enabled it returns the raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the caller assumes an axios-like shape (`const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;`). A `fetch` Response has no `.data`, so `token` becomes `undefined` and `token.access_token` will throw a `TypeError` in credential-sync mode. The diff shows no `await res.json()` or equivalent normalization before accessing `.data`.
